question: Which individual borrowers (each client CIF on its own, not rolled up to its group) also have more than $5 million of capital-markets credit exposure in their own name, and what is each one's combined exposure?
answer:
**Answer:** 14 client CIFs are borrowers with the bank and also have more than $5M of capital-markets current exposure booked to their own legal entity at 2026-09-30. Each one's combined exposure (lending commitment plus capital-markets exposure) is below. Together they come to about **$546.1M**: $244.9M of lending commitments and $301.2M of capital-markets exposure.

| # | CIF | Borrower | Cap-mkts current exposure (product) | Active lending commitment (drawn + undrawn) | Drawn | **Combined exposure** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0000042498 | Harrowgate Health Co | $37.16M | $29.20M (EQP, SBLC) | $17.12M | **$66.36M** |
| 2 | 0000041850 | Pinecrest Valley Group LLC | $38.83M | $20.45M (EQP, TL) | $17.19M | **$59.28M** |
| 3 | 0000041022 | Kestrel Automation Systems LLC | $6.50M | $45.00M (RLOC) | $31.67M | **$51.50M** |
| 4 | 0000042036 | Pinecrest Properties Inc | $32.04M | $13.85M (EQP) | $11.14M | **$45.89M** |
| 5 | 0000041642 | Yarrowby Industries LLC | $33.32M | $7.30M (ABL) | $4.29M | **$40.62M** |
| 6 | 0000042083 | Foxmere Valley Holdings LLC | $31.63M | $8.10M (TL) | $7.12M | **$39.73M** |
| 7 | 0000042648 | Calloway Health Inc | $24.27M | $14.25M (RLOC) | $6.64M | **$38.52M** |
| 8 | 0000041539 | Ravensholm Systems Inc | $33.62M | $2.60M (ABL) | $1.75M | **$36.22M** |
| 9 | 0000041974 | Ivorline Services Inc | $7.15M | $24.10M (TL, SBLC) | $9.41M | **$31.25M** |
| 10 | 0000042657 | Blackridge Supply LLC | $12.14M | $17.65M (SBLC) | $0.00M | **$29.79M** |
| 11 | 0000041168 | Dunmore Energy Inc | $6.14M | $23.10M (ABL, TL, RLOC) | $14.96M | **$29.24M** |
| 12 | 0000042037 | Pinecrest Distribution LLC | $10.77M | $16.25M (EQP) | $12.98M | **$27.02M** |
| 13 | 0000042233 | Kingsmere Ridge Group LLC | $18.44M | $8.40M (EQP, SBLC) | $4.06M | **$26.84M** |
| 14 | 0000042452 | Hollinsby Engineering Co | $9.17M | $14.65M (RLOC, ABL) | $10.13M | **$23.82M** |

If you count only drawn balances on the lending side, the totals are lower. For example, Harrowgate falls to $54.3M and Blackridge to $12.1M.

**Excluded, or worth a look:**
- **Halvorsen Capital Services LLC (CIF 0000041002)** has $22.0M of capital-markets exposure but no credit facilities, so it isn't a borrower.
- **Five entities with no CIF link** together hold $86.85M of capital-markets exposure: Moorcroft Global Opportunities Fund LP ($26.37M), Pinecrest Macro Fund LP ($19.05M), Moorcroft Macro Fund LP ($17.99M), Brandvold Macro Fund LP ($15.15M) and Hollinsby Capital Markets LLC ($8.29M). None matched a client CIF, so they can't be tied to a borrower.
- **Charged-off facilities were left out:** Pinecrest Valley Group has one with $1.34M still on the books, and Kingsmere Ridge has one with $6.25M. Both are rated 10. Kingsmere also has an active facility rated 7, so both names have credit-quality concerns as well as high exposure.
- **No group roll-up, as you asked.** Three of the names are Pinecrest entities (rows 2, 4 and 12) and stay on separate lines. They likely belong to one group, and together they would be much larger (about $132M).

**Sources and definitions**
- **Capital-markets exposure:** Fabric `dbo.CM_EXPOSURE`, 2026-09-30 snapshot, summed by entity. This is current exposure, equal to the trade's mark-to-market value when positive and zero otherwise; notional amounts were not used. Each qualifying entity had one trade.
- **Linking entities to clients:** `dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY.CIF_REF` holds a 5-digit CIF, which I zero-padded to match the 10-digit `CIF_NO` in Snowflake `CORE.CLIENT`. Every matched CIF mapped to exactly one entity. Exposure is direct only: no ownership roll-up and no guarantees.
- **Lending exposure:** Snowflake `LENDING.FACILITY` joined to `LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY` at 2026-09-30. I used active facilities only, measured as drawn plus undrawn, which equals the commitment. SBLCs are included at full face value even though they're off-balance-sheet. Paid-off and charged-off facilities are excluded.
- **Borrower:** a CIF with at least one active credit facility. All 14 clients are active.
- **Threshold:** strictly more than $5,000,000 of capital-markets current exposure in the entity's own name.

sql.sql: SELECT SNAP_DT, PRODUCT, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT TRADE_ID) trades, SUM(CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nulls, SUM(CASE WHEN CURRENT_EXPOSURE<>CASE WHEN MTM_AMT>0 THEN MTM_AMT ELSE 0 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ce_ne_mtm FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE GROUP BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT ORDER BY SNAP_DT, PRODUCT

SELECT ENTITY_TYP, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(CIF_REF) with_cif, COUNT(DISTINCT CIF_REF) dist_cif, MIN(LEN(CIF_REF)) minlen, MAX(LEN(CIF_REF)) maxlen, MIN(CIF_REF) mn, MAX(CIF_REF) mx FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY GROUP BY ENTITY_TYP

SELECT e.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF, COUNT(*) trades, SUM(e.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) ce, SUM(e.NOTIONAL_AMT) notional,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY x WHERE x.CIF_REF = le.CIF_REF) cif_dups
FROM dbo.CM_EXPOSURE e LEFT JOIN dbo.LEGAL_ENTITY le ON le.ENTITY_ID = e.ENTITY_ID
WHERE e.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
GROUP BY e.ENTITY_ID, le.ENTITY_NM, le.ENTITY_TYP, le.CIF_REF
HAVING SUM(e.CURRENT_EXPOSURE) > 5000000
ORDER BY ce DESC

SELECT f.FACILITY_STATUS, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(b.FACILITY_ID) with_sep_bal, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn, SUM(b.UNDRAWN_AMT) undrawn, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit, MIN(f.PAYOFF_DT), MAX(f.CHGOFF_DT)
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT CIF_NO, CLIENT_NM, SEGMENT_CD, CLIENT_STATUS FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT WHERE LTRIM(CIF_NO,'0') IN ('41850','42498','41539','41642','42036','42083','42648','41002','42233','42657','42037','42452','41974','41022','41168') OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE '%Fund LP%' OR CLIENT_NM ILIKE '%Capital Markets%' ORDER BY CIF_NO

SELECT f.CIF_NO, f.FACILITY_STATUS, COUNT(*) n_fac, LISTAGG(f.PRODUCT_CD, ',') prods, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) commit, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) drawn, SUM(b.UNDRAWN_AMT) undrawn, MAX(f.RISK_RATING) max_rr
FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b ON b.FACILITY_ID=f.FACILITY_ID AND b.SNAP_DT='2026-09-30'
WHERE f.CIF_NO IN ('0000041850','0000042498','0000041539','0000041642','0000042036','0000042083','0000042648','0000041002','0000042233','0000042657','0000042037','0000042452','0000041974','0000041022','0000041168')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
